subject: NorthBridge: standby cluster and airgapped analytics node — renewal + expansion plan
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgebio.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northbridgebio.com, tim.mahoney@northbridgebio.com
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the heads up on the renewal timeline. Two requests from our infra/architecture team as we plan next fiscal year:

1) Add two standby clusters in our us-west VPC (cold standby, must be isolated from shared analytics).
2) An airgapped analytics node for PHI processing (on-prem equivalent or private VPC with HSM support).

We have a hard compliance deadline at the start of Q4, so the timeline on provisioning matters. Also, our procurement/finance team will need any term changes and indicative pricing for a 24-month commitment (we prefer committed capacity to lock pricing).

Can you confirm whether these can be included in the renewal SOW and provide an updated cost delta + rough delivery timeline?

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
NorthBridge Bio
[Attachment: NB-reqs-brief.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgebio.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Elena — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Yes, we can scope two standby clusters in your us-west private VPC and provide an isolated airgapped analytics node.
- Two options for delivery: (A) private VPC reserved nodes (fully managed by Redwood) — faster (6–8 weeks) or (B) on-prem packaged deploy (airgap) — longer (10–14 weeks) depending on site readiness.

I attached a draft SOW with both options and a cost delta for a 24-month committed term. We can present to procurement this week.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly: can you lead pricing for the committed + standby cluster uplift?
- Monica: can you confirm SLA/uptime and add-on fees for airgapped support?
- Neha: would you own any SOC2 evidence requests once procurement asks?

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync with NorthBridge to walk through the SOW and timelines — Elena, what times work for you tomorrow or Wednesday?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_NorthBridge_v3.pdf (application/pdf) 210KB]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Quick pricing note:

- Standby clusters (2 x c8-standard-equivalent pools) as private VPC reserved capacity: ~$42,500/month additional at commit, inclusive of 5% reserved discount for 24 months.
- Airgapped analytics node (on-prem package + support): one-time setup $85,000 + $12,000/month managed support.
- If they choose the fully managed private VPC airgapped variant, we can reduce the one-time setup to $40,000 and amortize across the commitment.

I'll add this as an appendix to the SOW. Recommend offering a 60-day provisioning SLA for the private VPC option and 120-day SLA for the on-prem package.

-Kim

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgebio.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northbridgebio.com, tim.mahoney@northbridgebio.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Thanks — that pricing helps. Procurement would like the following clarified before we set a legal review:

- Payment terms for the one-time setup (net 30 vs. amortized across the term).
- Whether the standby clusters will incur per-token usage charges during standby (should be zero except for health-check traffic).
- Data residency controls for the airgapped node and KMS/HSM controls.

Tim (cc): can you confirm internal procurement windows — we need a signed SOW by May 15 to meet our internal timelines.

Best,
Elena

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgebio.com>, procurement@northbridgebio.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, tim.mahoney@northbridgebio.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 07:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Elena / Tim / team — answering the clarifications: 

- Payment terms: we can offer net 30 on the one-time setup or amortize it across a 24-month commitment at no additional margin. If amortized, we reduce the upfront cash impact and apply the committed reserved discount.
- Standby clusters: configured as cold-standby — they will not incur per-token generation charges while idle; only minimal health-check traffic (metered per our health-check baseline) — we'll add a note to the SOW.
- KMS/HSM: airgapped node supports customer-managed keys (HSM integration) — Neha will provide the SOC2 and KMS integration checklist.

I attached the updated SOW that includes payment options and technical appendix with HSM/KMS bullet points.

Proposed next: 30-min SOW review Thursday 10am PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign link for the SOW preview.

Thanks,
Dylan
[Attachment: SOW_NorthBridge_v3.1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tim Mahoney <tim.mahoney@northbridgebio.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgebio.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridgebio.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — standby/airgapped ask

Dylan — thanks for the walk-through earlier. Procurement has reviewed the amortization option and prefers to amortize the setup across the 24-month term (helps our cash flows). A couple of asks from legal before signing:

- Confirm rollback/exit obligations for the airgapped on-prem node (we need a data return and wipe window defined).
- Include an SLA credit schedule tied to provisioning milestones for the private VPC standby clusters.

If you can send updated SOW with amortized fees and the two legal bullets addressed, we can run to signature next week.

Tim Mahoney
Head of Procurement
NorthBridge Bio
[Attachment: NB-legal-questions.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
